display_name: EuroQol- 5 Dimension (EQ-5D): 3. Usual Activities *(e.g., work, study, housework, family, or leisure activities)*
description:
Item from EuroQol- 5 Dimension (EQ-5D), a five-dimension descriptive system to assess generic-quality of life. Higher scores correlate with reduced productivity or social participation. [EuroQol Research Foundation. EQ-5D-3L User Guide, 2018.](https://euroqol.org/publications/user-guides)
